content: The classification and monitoring of chronic kidney disease (CKD) by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) include the following albuminuria categories: 1. A1 (Normal to mildly increased albuminuria): This category is defined by an albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) of less than 30 mg/g. 2. A2 (Moderately increased albuminuria): This category is characterized by an ACR ranging between 30 and 299 mg/g. 3. A3 (Severely increased albuminuria): This category is identified by an ACR of 300 mg/g or greater.
